$comment: SealLink v1.0 Canonical Object Type Registry. Authoritative SSOT for object types, byte limits, signing roles, and schema targets. Signing domain tag equals the exact type string under SPEC-01.

types.description: Name-pinned operational manifest: off-chain set heads (card, certs, salted Merkle auth & devices, members), self-service declaration, pinned labeled providers, optional role-policy preimages (verified against on-chain link.<role> hashes), and notary/release log bindings.

Public unsigned entity metadata card (person, agent, organization, service) with optional content-addressed avatar/avatars and safe-scheme links[], authenticated solely via name -> manifest -> card SHA-256 chain.

Manifest-pinned fixed-256-leaf salted Merkle root head committing to an actor's foreign-service authentication keys (sets.auth) with CSPRNG dummy-leaf size-hiding selective disclosure (proof.steps length == 8).
Salted leaf entry inside sets.auth (BIP-340 H_tag domain-separated leaf digest, alg in {bip340, p256, ed25519}, individual disposable fast-revocation seal).

Manifest-pinned fixed-256-leaf salted Merkle root head committing to an actor's owner control-plane devices (sets.devices) with CSPRNG dummy-leaf size-hiding selective disclosure (proof.steps length == 8).
Salted leaf entry inside sets.devices (BIP-340 H_tag domain-separated leaf digest, alg in {bip340, p256, ed25519}, presence claim, L0-L2 ceiling, individual disposable fast-revocation seal).
Manifest-pinned list of managed/member names with owner policy pins, optional free role tags, and per-entry revocation seals.
Manifest-pinned head committing to an actor's complete set of self-issued key-binding, identity-link, profile-section, and configuration statements.

Typed actor-, guardian-quorum-, device-, or service-signed statement for external transport key bindings, unilateral identity links (reciprocally confirmable via peer statement or members list), extensible profile sections, host configuration sections, trust-root rotation/cancellation, or migration acceptance/fencing.
L0/L1/L2 owner control-plane command for an actor's own executors and managed agent key holders; verified via salted Merkle inclusion in sets.devices; never valid at foreign verifiers.
Single-use foreign-service login challenge (provisional key-only or named mode via salted Merkle sets.auth; bip340/p256/ed25519; network/genesis/optional audience), TTL <= 120s.
Atomic promotion of a provisional key-only service cell to a confirmed named SealLink identity under the same auth algorithm/key verified via salted Merkle sets.auth.

Eternal Origin Certificate establishing immutable subject class (person, agent, organization), salted initial guardian commitments, explicit disposer/arbiter/challenger keys, revision-denominated quorum rules, status/roster UTXO spines, and name_recovery policy.
Single-use binding record linking an eternal Origin Certificate to a specific name registration outpoint, ScriptPolicy, and optional successor recovery seal.

Acyclic revocable guardianship record signed by the origin's issuer (link.cred) and anchored via disposer+arbiter PSBT spend for direct initial activation (mode=initial, 0x12) or two-stage successor appointment/activation (mode=appointed, 0x0d -> 0x0e).

Governed roster transition signed by the origin's issuer (link.cred) and authorized on-chain by disposer+arbiter roster_seal spend (0x0f), advancing revision, adjusting approved revision_size, rotating institutional keys, or re-anchoring burned slots.
Eternal emancipation / legal-capacity record transitioning a ward toward autonomous status upon status_seal spend and confirmed name transfer.
Eternal subject-end record (human death, agent dematerialization, organization dissolution) spending status_seal terminally and permanently closing guardianship and admission.

N-party structured contract with salted per-clause selective disclosure, explicit machine_clause_indices, ward origin_id party binding, optional framework link, confirmed contract termination seal, and optional agreed configuration hash.
Symmetric native party assent binding a signer (via signatures) or a ward's guardian quorum (via guardian_approvals[]) to a contract, guardianship appointment, or migration manifest.

Signed termination evidence committed inside a contract-seal spend (action 0x08); signed by a contract party's grant key, ward guardian quorum, or contract arbiter (the seal spend alone terminates regardless of 0x08 validity).
Chained violation verdict record referencing salted request/response hashes and rule identifier, optionally anchored in grant-seal spend (0x03).
General third-party verifiable credential (eternal or revocable), anchored by signed-form content address (0x09) and bounded by compromise height h_c (0x0b).

Unsigned cause commitment authenticated by spending a revocable credential seal (action 0x0a), guardianship slot seal (action 0x0a), notary seal (action 0x05), or delegation row stop coin (action 0x05).
Chain-reconstructible compromise-height (h_c) break payload authenticated by the issuer's name OwnerPolicy (action 0x0b).

General notary act (contract notarization, document copy, fact attestation, optional child-grant attestation, or artifact-notarization), supporting eternal (0x04), revocable (0x04 + seal), and log_tracked (0x14 transparency/denial log) lifecycles.

Universal revocable (or root-only short-lived window_only) capability grant: unilateral by default, optionally contract-bound, signed via signatures or ward guardian_approvals[], with 7-predicate Constraint Algebra, separate additive quotas, and bounded depth-2 re-delegation.
Canonical issuance preparation committed in action 0x01 OP_RETURN (or 0x02 root batch leaf), binding genesis, grant_id, grant_content_addr, and contract_id (present iff grant carries contract_id).
Signed execution request carrying concrete action, target, typed arguments, ordered proof path, nonce, and wall-clock [iat, exp) window.
Executor-signed accounting and outcome receipt (executed, refused, uncertain) with reserved, settled, and released quota amounts.
Signed invocation establishing, extending, or closing a short-lived (<= 3600s) bearer session for non-signing clients (root issuer link.grant MAY sign op='close').

Canonical entry in an anti-rollback hash-chained journal (closures, atomic pending reservations, unified atomic terminal settlements including single-use consumption, nonces, manifest heads, session-state with token_sha256, durable session-use debits, migration-applied, recovery boundaries).

Replaceable-service portable state and accounting handover manifest signed by the source provider's receipt key, paired with holder seallink-assent/1 and destination seallink-statement/1 (migration-accept).

Publisher-signed software or artifact release attestation under link.release, binding product_id, version_str, monotonic release_seq, canonical artifact_identity, and target_sha256, anchored via 0x09 (eternal) or 0x14 (log_tracked).

UTXO-chained transparency and denial log checkpoint anchored by OP_RETURN 0x14 committing batch_root, denials_delta_root, Fixed-Depth-256 SMT denials_root, and acyclic RFC 9162 checkpoints_root over predecessors 1..(seq-1).
Signed denial/revocation entry recorded in a notary or release log SMT under key act:<id>|*, rel:<id>|*, or target:<target_id>|* (including mandatory fail -> target: entries).
Signed monotonic state-advancing reinstatement (state_seq >= 2, chained via prev_record_id) for a previously revoked log denial_key without ever deleting the SMT leaf back to E.

Publicly verifiable 4-mode fraud proof (equivocation, revocation_omission, illegal_reversion, invalid_checkpoint_chain) permanently closing a compromised notary or release log_id with NOTARY_LOG_COMPROMISED.

Offline-verifiable artifact admission bundle carrying canonical artifact_identity, optional seallink-release/1, 0..N log-tracked or eternal notary attestations, SMT absence proofs, and optional absent-notary veto absence proofs.

Paginated Tier-2 SPV response carrying consensus-exact SegWitNameUpdateProof entries (coinbase depth, BIP-141 wtxid commitment, stripped BIP-143 scriptCode, strict BIP-66 DER + SIGHASH_ALL) for a Namecoin registration lineage.
